api: Public JSON API of the site's own backend (the base URL and the resource routes are named in the site's own Nuxt bundles): base https://backend.ketabonline.com/api/v2. Title search: GET /books?is_active=1&is_deleted=0&limit=<n>&sort_field=_score&sort_direction=desc&q=<query>&scope=titles -> paginated {data, meta.total} (الفلك -> 20 title hits). FULL-CONTENT search: GET /books/pages?limit=<n>&q=<query>&lang=ar -> paginated page hits (الفلك -> 108,283 page hits; البيروني -> 4,721), each hit naming its book {id, title, lang}, its part and its page number, and carrying the page's HTML. Book record: GET /books/<book_id> -> the book's record (title, authors [{id, name}], pages_count, parts, publisher). Author filter: GET /books?authors=<author_id> -> exactly that author's books (author 337 البيروني -> 4 books). Book text: GET /books/<book_id>/pages/<page> -> one page's full text as JSON {id, page, book, part, content: the page's HTML}; GET /books/<book_id>/pages -> the book's page-number list. No key, no login.
name: KetabOnline — جامع الكتب الإسلامية (ketabonline.com)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §50 (probed 2026-11-26 from the build sandbox, multi-route): جامع الكتب الإسلامية — the platform's own counts, verified in its server-rendered home page: 29,365 text books, 15,076,177 pages, 2,637 authors, 46 sections. Routes tried: (1) the home page / answers 200 server-rendered (Nuxt) at /ar — the catalogue is genuinely open, no login; (2) the site's search UI offers three scopes (titles عناوين الكتب / contents محتوى الكتب / authors المؤلفون) and navigates to /ar/books?q=<q>&scope=<scope> — that SSR results page answers 200; (3) the backend JSON API named in the site's own JS bundles (base https://backend.ketabonline.com/api/v2) answers 200 with no key: title search, full-content search (108,283 page hits for الفلك), book records, the author filter, and the reader route below; (4) book text GET /books/<id>/pages/<n> answers 200 with the page's real prose in the content field — read verbatim during the probe: book 992 تحقيق ما للهند p. 100 (the Sanskrit-syllable tables chapter) and p. 200; book 102678 الآثار الباقية p. 50 (al-Sijzi and the Persian month names) — its pp. 100/200 are heading/table pages and fail the text bar, as designed; book 165 الجماهر p. 50 (3,030 chars, the Ibn al-Rumi pearl verses); book 55071 تحقيق ما للهند (ط. أخرى) p. 100; book 57086 من علم الفلك القرآني p. 10; book 16590 الكشف عن حقيقة الصوفية p. 487; (5) the human reader route /ar/books/<id>/read?page=<n> answers 200 SSR — the API route is cleaner and is the one wired; (6) sitemap GET /sitemap.xml answers 200 but is catalogue-only — not needed; robots.txt -> 404; (7) OAI-PMH -> 404 on ketabonline.com, on backend.ketabonline.com and on /api/v2 — no OAI route exists; (8) index fallbacks (Crossref/DOAJ/Unpaywall/OpenAlex/IA) not needed — the direct route is proven. PRIMARY SEEDS: the platform hosts FOUR of al-Biruni's own works under its author record البيروني (author id 337, books_count 4, confirmed via GET /books?authors=337): تحقيق ما للهند (book 992, 484 pp), الآثار الباقية عن القرون الخالية (book 102678, 448 pp), تحقيق ما للهند ط أخرى (book 55071, 418 pp) and الجماهر في معرفة الجواهر (book 165, 113 pp) — each seeded below, one page of each fetched and read during the probe; candidates from them are marked primary. NOT HOSTED: القانون المسعودي (a 66-hit title scan shows only مسعود-name noise), التفهيم (title search total 0) and تحديد نهايات الأماكن — so no seed exists for them. The platform's relevance scoring is loose (title searches return hundreds of weak matches), so the searcher wires the full-CONTENT search and never trusts the match: passages come only from fetched pages.
